headlines.headline: COURT-ORDERED FIFTH-YEAR ELIGIBILITY RULING OPENS A RARE AUGUST TRANSFER PORTAL WINDOW, AUG. 3-10
headlines.detail: Days after U.S. District Judge Charlotte Sweeney's preliminary injunction restored a fifth season of eligibility to Division I athletes who began competing in 2022-23, the NCAA opened a special transfer portal window running Aug. 3-10 for the newly eligible players; with most programs already having spent their scholarship money, coaches are bracing for a chaotic late-summer scramble even as the NCAA is expected to appeal.

headlines.headline: NUGGETS' PEYTON WATSON STILL UNSIGNED AS RESTRICTED FREE AGENCY DRAGS INTO AUGUST
headlines.detail: Denver guard Peyton Watson remains without a new deal as August opens, reportedly seeking an average annual value north of the $25 million-plus extension teammate Christian Braun secured this summer; Watson's holdout is one of the NBA's last unresolved free-agency dominoes, alongside Detroit's Jalen Duren, after a wild offseason that already sent LeBron James to Philadelphia and Giannis Antetokounmpo to Miami.

headlines.headline: SAINTS DT BRYAN BRESEE TO UNDERGO SEASON-ENDING ACL SURGERY
headlines.detail: New Orleans starting defensive tackle Bryan Bresee will have surgery on a torn ACL and miss the entire 2026 season, a significant blow to a Saints defensive front already thin up the middle, as all 32 teams settle into the second week of training camp.

headlines.headline: DEION SANDERS OPENS YEAR FOUR AT COLORADO WITH FALL CAMP IN COLORADO SPRINGS
headlines.detail: Colorado began fall camp today away from Boulder, practicing at UCCS and Fountain-Fort Carson High School through Aug. 8, as Sanders tries to integrate a nation-leading haul of 43 transfer portal additions after last season's 3-9 finish; the Buffaloes open the 2026 season Sept. 3 at Georgia Tech.
